verdicts.reason: Both break the original the same way. The frame outline that should surround the headline floats empty near the top, a grey panel and the bulb icon are grouped as a stray cluster under the text, and the leaf imagery is reduced to a blur at the top edge, so most of the eco feel is lost. A is worse because the grey panel and icon sit jammed against the bottom edge and the headline sits low, leaving the upper half empty. B gives that bottom group a margin and spaces things more evenly, so it reads slightly better.
